# Bootstrap 5.3.8

Vendored production CSS and bundled JavaScript from the official Bootstrap release:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE

Files were checked against the SHA-384 integrity hashes published in
https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/getting-started/introduction/.
The bundled JavaScript includes Popper. Keep the accompanying MIT licence.
